summary.interpretation: This probe tests signal observation and propagation only. Survival for 90 seconds does not identify the historical sender, prove environmental stability, or validate model numerical behavior.

launcher preserves child exit and does not clean up
stderr and launcher console are empty
passive observer completes without signals or model access
observer sample count matches sealed rows
observer captured owned processes and their actual cgroup
trace covers coordinator and worker completion
90 seconds without injected or received selected signals
no fixture exception or timeout cleanup
